title: Guest Bandwidth Control (QoS)
summary: Caps guest speed with either lightweight tc rules or SQM using the Cake algorithm. Known issues: the tc directions are swapped (the download value limits upload and vice versa) and SQM targets the interface name guest instead of the bridge device.

items.title: Simple Limit (tc) - Lightweight
items.description: Creates an HTB rate limit script for the guest bridge and re-applies it at every boot.
items.usage_tip: Defaults are 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload, but they are applied in the opposite direction.

items.title: Advanced Limit (SQM + Cake) - Better quality
items.description: Configures SQM with Cake on the guest interface for smoother latency under load.
items.usage_tip: Installs sqm-scripts if missing. Check that SQM accepts the guest interface on your device.

items.title: Remove all Guest QoS
items.description: Deletes the tc script, its boot entry and the SQM section, then clears the live rules.
items.usage_tip: Use it if guests report dropped or throttled connections.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Guest Network menu.
